description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian sectors foreign portfolio investors are buying or selling, using fortnightly NSDL data.

Returns, for each fortnight NSDL reports, FPI net investment and assets under custody by sector, in Rs crore and USD million, covering all FPIs across both depositories from 2012. `from_date` and `to_date` are ISO dates matched to the fortnight's end; the default is the last six months, and the longest window is five years unless `sector` is given. `sector` is one of NSDL's own sector names, or "Grand Total" for all sectors: call without `sector` to see the names. They changed on 30 April 2022, so a name may match only one side of that date. `instrument` selects the column: "equity" (default), debt_general, debt_vrr, debt_far, hybrid, aif, total, mf_equity, mf_debt, mf_hybrid, mf_solution_oriented or mf_other; before 2020 only equity, debt_general and total were reported. `include_subsectors` adds the older sub-sector rows, which are already counted in their parent.
name: get_sector_fpi_investment
title: FPI investment by sector
